attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Mississippi state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per Miss. Code § 27-7-5: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 4.4%. Standard deductions: $2,300 Single/MFS, $4,600 MFJ/QSS, $3,400 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " Mississippi Tax Calculation (top marginal 4.4%)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Mississippi Tax Calculation (top marginal 4.4%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 4600.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.044
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 4600.0 f- 0.0 fmax /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.044 f* /result.computed_state_tax xdef " MS MFJ taxable income (AGI - $4,600): $" result.computed_state_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " MS state tax (4.4%): $" result.computed_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 3400.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.044
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 3400.0 f- 0.0 fmax /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.044 f* /result.computed_state_tax xdef " MS HOH taxable income (AGI - $3,400): $" result.computed_state_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " MS state tax (4.4%): $" result.computed_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 2300.0 f- 0.0 fmax /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.044 f* /result.computed_state_tax xdef " MS Single/MFS taxable income (AGI - $2,300): $" result.computed_state_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " MS state tax (4.4%): $" result.computed_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
